source_pages_inspected: PDF 17-18 / article 15-16: effects, discussion, authors conclusions

source.scaffold: cd006649-pass00-global.md plus the user-quoted LMWH-vs-UFH batch guidance

duplicate_review.cross_batch_note: Comparison-specific quantitative atoms were intentionally deferred from the general and studybase runs. A semantic duplicate review should still be repeated after all CD006649 batches are merged.

source_inconsistencies_requiring_human_r.issue: GRADE certainty language differs within the review for LMWH versus UFH.
locations: Summary of Findings 1 / Abstract / Plain Language Summary: low certainty for mortality and recurrent VTE
Discussion, Quality of the evidence (article p. 16 / PDF p. 18): moderate certainty for all tested LMWH-versus-UFH outcomes
source_inconsistencies_requiring_human_r.handling: Both source assertions were preserved. The structured Summary of Findings ratings were not silently overwritten by the Discussion wording.

source_inconsistencies_requiring_human_r.issue: Breddin 2001 cancer-subgroup denominators differ across source locations.
locations: Results narrative (article p. 12 / PDF p. 14): 83 people with cancer
Characteristics table (article p. 28 / PDF p. 30; prior studybase extraction): 137 people with cancer
Analysis 1.1 and 1.2 forest plots (article pp. 49-50 / PDF pp. 51-52): 84 LMWH + 41 UFH = 125 participants in each Breddin row
source_inconsistencies_requiring_human_r.handling: Forest-plot event counts and denominators were preserved exactly in secondary-reported subgroup-result atoms and tagged breddin_count_review_needed; no reconciliation was invented.

schema_gaps: LiteratureAtom schema version 1.0 is oriented to primary literature, while CD006649 is a systematic review.
GRADE certainty has no dedicated structured field; certainty and downgrading reasons are preserved in OTHER atoms and tags.
Meta-analysis heterogeneity has no dedicated result object; I² is represented conservatively as a QUANTITATIVE_RESULT with outcome and comparison context.

Forest-plot study rows are secondary reports of trial cancer-subgroup results; SUBGROUP_RESULT atoms are anchored to the Cochrane review and tagged secondary_reported_trial, not treated as primary-study extractions.
The schema has no structured field for forest-plot study weights, so weights are not normalized into atom context.
extraction_limitations: Pass 0 was used only as scaffold/routing context; atoms were extracted from the original CD006649 source locations for this batch.

The batch preserves pooled relative effects, absolute effects, GRADE statements, heterogeneity, forest-plot study rows, missing outcomes, sensitivity analysis, and author interpretation for LMWH versus UFH.
The mortality sensitivity-analysis participant denominator was not reported in the inspected narrative and was not calculated from heterogeneous secondary sources.
Individual primary publications were not read; trial-row atoms remain secondary-reported results from the Cochrane forest plots.
All atoms are machine-extracted and marked needs_review; structural/schema/sufficiency validation does not constitute human source-fidelity verification.
